title: Provider Registry Entry
description: One externally maintained provider, stored as isvctl/configs/provider-registry/<name>.yaml. The provider's config/ and scripts/ live in the partner's own repository; this entry pins the exact commit that was validated. The loader additionally checks that `name` equals the filename stem and that every entry in `suites` exists under isvctl/configs/suites/.

name.description: Registry name, used by `isvctl provider fetch <name>`. Must equal the filename stem.

vendor.description: Legal entity that maintains the provider.

description.description: One-sentence summary shown by `isvctl provider list`.

repo_url.description: HTTPS clone URL of the partner repository holding the provider's config/ and scripts/.

commit.description: Full 40-character commit SHA that was validated. Required unless status is experimental.

ref.description: Optional human-readable tag or branch for `commit`. An experimental entry may give only a ref, in which case fetched content is not reproducible.

tested_with.description: isvctl release (X.Y.Z or X.Y.Z-rcN, without a leading v) this commit was validated against.

maintainers.description: Partner contacts. GitHub handles are the ones added to CODEOWNERS for this entry.

documentation_url.description: HTTPS URL of instructions that let a user with appropriate access reproduce the validation results.

status.description: qualified: pinned and validated. experimental: may be unpinned, results not reproducible. deprecated: hidden from `isvctl provider list` unless --all.
